# YellowDog Provider

Manage [YellowDog](https://yellowdog.ai/) configuration as code.

## Example Usage

Requires Terraform 1.0 or later.

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    yellowdog = {
      source = "yellowdogai/yellowdog"
    }
  }
}

provider "yellowdog" {}
```

### Authentication

The provider authenticates with a YellowDog [application](https://docs.yellowdog.ai/#/the-platform/applications)'s API key.
The simplest option is to provide the key with environment variables:

```shell
export YD_API_KEY_ID=...
export YD_API_KEY_SECRET=...
```

Alternatively read the key from a secrets manager, such as HashiCorp Vault, and pass it to the `provider` block:

```terraform
provider "yellowdog" {
  api_key_id     = ephemeral.vault_kv_secret_v2.yellowdog.data.api_key_id
  api_key_secret = ephemeral.vault_kv_secret_v2.yellowdog.data.api_key_secret
}
```

!> Never write your API key secret as a literal value in configuration files. Anyone who can read the file can use the
key, and the file may be committed to source control.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key_id` (String, Sensitive) The ID of a YellowDog application's API key. May also be set via the YD_API_KEY_ID environment variable.
- `api_key_secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret of a YellowDog application's API key. May also be set via the YD_API_KEY_SECRET environment variable.
- `api_url` (String) Base URL for the YellowDog API. May also be set via the YD_API_URL environment variable. Defaults to the production API.
- `timeout` (String) Default per-request timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. "60s"). Defaults to "30s".
